rootCauseOneLine: bb-app's native add-ons (better-sqlite3, node-pty) are only built by npm install scripts; npm 11's allowScripts policy is advisory (scripts still run, so the reporter's npm 11.17 mechanism is refuted), but npm 12 (registry latest since 2026-07-08) blocks unreviewed dependency scripts by default and, for -g/npx installs, ignores the package's own allowScripts, so every bb install path (npm -g, npx, install.sh, daemon self-update) that passes no --allow-scripts yields a bb that crashes with "Could not locate the bindings file" / "Failed to load native module: pty.node"; the PATH sub-issue was already fixed by #1419.
proposedFix: Add --allow-scripts=better-sqlite3,node-pty,@parcel/watcher to both `npm install -g` lines in apps/server/src/assets/install-machine.sh and to the self-updater argv in apps/host-daemon/src/protocol-self-update.ts (defaultInstallTarball); verified end to end that this makes the npm 12.0.2 machine join succeed, that npm 11 accepts the flag and npm 10.9.9 ignores it. After npm install, verify `require(better-sqlite3)`/`require(node-pty)` load and fail the installer loudly with a pointer to --allow-scripts / ignore-scripts (diff in 1120/repro/1120-installer-fix.diff; requires updating the fake npm and argv regexes in apps/server/test/app/install-machine-script.test.ts). Document `npx --allow-scripts=better-sqlite3,node-pty,@parcel/watcher bb-app@latest` (or `npm config set allow-scripts=... --location=user`) in the README quick start/troubleshooting and packages/bb-app/README.md. Longer term, node:sqlite removes better-sqlite3 from the list. No wire changes, no HOST_DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION bump.
caveats: The reporter's own breakage on npm 11.17.0 could not be reproduced (npm 11.16/11.17 run the scripts and bb starts; the maintainer found the same); the reporter never posted the actual error, so their root cause is unverified. The reproduced failure requires npm 12.0.x, which is registry `latest` but not yet bundled with any released Node (Node 24.19 ships 11.17.0, Node 26.7 ships 11.19.0). Tested on Linux only; the macOS installer path was checked by code reading (#1419 removed the PATH check). Tests used bb-app@latest = 0.38.0 from the registry plus the base-commit tarball served by my dev server, not 0.35.1. Once a CLI policy is passed, npm 12 skips all other unlisted scripts (currently only @google/genai's no-op preinstall and protobufjs's postinstall; bb ran fine without them).
